subjects.title: Sports Proficiency and Participation in Sports Competitions (Inter-Collegiate Level)

units.title: Physical Fitness and Training Preparation
units.topics: Major components of physical fitness: Strength, Endurance, Flexibility, Speed, Agility, Balance, Coordination, Reaction Time, Body Composition, Daily exercise, practice matches, nutrition, rest and recovery.

units.title: Competitive Participation and Sports Proficiency
units.topics: Selection of individual or team sport, regular training under coaches/teachers, participation in inter-collegiate sports competitions, inter-zonal and inter-university sports competitions, sports proficiency and achievements.
